data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and names the right parameters, but it leaves out the passengers and filters parameters and describes the multi-city leg setup only loosely; it is concrete enough to automate.
